items.prompt:
In a chemical reaction, atoms form
A) new substances
B) nothing
C) only heat
D) only light

Metals tend to ____ electrons.
A) lose
B) gain
C) never move
D) destroy

steps: Metals tend to lose outer electrons.

items.prompt:
Nonmetals tend to ____ electrons.
A) lose
B) gain
C) ignore
D) create

Metals react with nonmetals because
A) metals lose electrons and nonmetals gain them
B) both gain electrons
C) neither reacts
D) they repel completely
items.answer: A) metals lose electrons and nonmetals gain them

items.prompt:
A noble gas with a full outer electron level is
A) very reactive
B) very unreactive
C) a metal
D) always on the left

steps: A full outer level makes it unreactive.

items.prompt:
When sodium loses an electron and chlorine gains it, they form
A) a compound (sodium chloride)
B) two noble gases
C) pure metal
D) nothing

The best explanation for sodium reacting with chlorine is
A) sodium loses an electron that chlorine gains, so they combine into sodium chloride
B) both gain electrons and repel
C) neither has electrons
D) they are noble gases
items.answer: A) sodium loses an electron that chlorine gains, so they combine into sodium chloride

steps: Electron transfer bonds them into a compound.

items.prompt:
Two elements, one that easily loses electrons and one that easily gains them, will
A) react readily to form a compound
B) never react
C) stay as noble gases
D) repel forever
items.answer: A) react readily to form a compound

steps: Opposite tendencies produce a ready reaction.
